question: Should Oracle expose a durable metadata-only `import-chatgpt-url` workflow before browser authentication and prior-turn verification occur on the first follow-up?
rationale: The patch adds a new persistent CLI/session contract rather than repairing an established behavior, and automated checks cannot determine whether this workflow matches the intended browser UX.

options.title: Accept the import workflow
options.body: Approve the new CLI contract after the contributor supplies redacted real browser proof and removes the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Keep manual conversations outside session storage
options.body: Decline the command and retain the current behavior in which only Oracle-created browser sessions are resumable.

recommendation.title: Accept the import workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the new CLI contract after the contributor supplies redacted real browser proof and removes the release-owned changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser follow-up and session-resume behavior appears to originate in the browser baseline associated with this contributor.
